name: Mount Tom Day Camp
description_short: Day camp on the New Rochelle and Pelham Manor line for ages 3 to 15, with two swims a day including Red Cross lessons, sports, arts, a climbing wall and specialties such as horseback riding, circus arts and STEM. Each group is led by a professional educator, and families pick 2 to 8 weeks.
notes: 2027 rates for full day (9 to 4, ages 3 to 15): 2 weeks $3,525, 3 weeks $4,875, 4 weeks $6,350, 5 weeks $7,350, 6 weeks $8,250, 7 weeks $8,950, 8 weeks $9,350. Mini day (9 to 2, ages 3 to 5 and a half) $2,950 to $7,100; half day early childhood (8:30 to 12:30, ages 3 to 4 and a half) $2,450 to $5,450. Bus service is included except Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens ($50 a week extra). Drop off and pick up at camp available 8 am to 6 pm. $800 deposit per child holds a spot. Groups from first grade up are single sex; nursery, kindergarten and Seniors (12 to 14) are co-ed.
